ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-cream chunky mash-like pieces, soft and slightly crumbly with rough broken edges, some cubes about 1-2 cm, with light golden tinges on edges, sitting in a mound across the upper-center of the plate covering roughly 30% of plate area, about 3 cm tall | 210
ITEM 2 | Thin sliced brown mushroom pieces, glossy and slightly oily with darker browned edges and visible cooking marks, scattered in a dense irregular pile on the left side covering roughly 20% of plate area, about 1.5 cm tall | 120
ITEM 3 | Dark brown seared meat pieces with firm texture, slightly glossy, browned exterior with some darker crust, cut into irregular chunks about 3-4 cm long, arranged on the right side covering roughly 12% of plate area, about 2 cm tall | 130
ITEM 4 | Small dark green herb or vegetable bits, matte and slightly leafy, a few scattered pieces about 1 cm between the mash and meat, covering under 2% of plate area, flat | 5
ITEM 5 | Pale yellow-cream small cauliflower-like florets with slightly golden browned spots, scattered loosely near the bottom edge and right of the mash, covering roughly 5% of plate area, about 2 cm tall | 45
